title: Document source users
subtitle: Which staff users are pinned to which document source, and who last changed each pin.

access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

import.title: Import document source users
import.format: One user per line, its columns separated by tabs as WPF reads them: user ID, document source. Add a third column holding X to delete that user's pin. There is no header row: a header would be read as a user.
import.paste: Or paste the rows (straight from Excel)
import.readFailed: The file could not be read as text. In Excel, save it as "Unicode Text" and pick it again, or paste its rows.
import.summary_one: <n>{{n}}</n> line: <upserts>{{upserts}}</upserts> to add or update, <deletes>{{deletes}}</deletes> to delete
import.summary_other: <n>{{n}}</n> lines: <upserts>{{upserts}}</upserts> to add or update, <deletes>{{deletes}}</deletes> to delete
import.blocked_one: <n>{{n}}</n> line has the wrong number of columns. Fix it to send.
import.blocked_other: <n>{{n}}</n> lines have the wrong number of columns. Fix them to send.
import.failedTitle: The import may not have been applied — the list was reloaded, check it before sending again
import.refusedTitle: The import was refused — nothing was applied
